items: Fit Type - Regular. Please refer to the size charts for details.
Size - S=US(4-6), M=US(8-10), L=US(12-14), XL=US(16-18), XXL=US(20-22). More details in rich description.

Material - 100% Rayon. Stretch - Non, Thickness - Slight, Softness - Medium. Recommended to machine wash cold in a laundry bag. Wash with similar colors together. Do not bleach. Hang to dry. The maximum stream temperature should not exceed 110℃.

Features - Women's casual palazzo pants, smocked elastic waist, wide leg, long, plaid&stripe design, soft and breathable. Our pants are perfect for daily wear, lounging at home, hanging around outside, traveling, vacation, or office work. Easily matched with slippers, heels or sneakers.
Notice - Actual colors may slightly vary due to lighting conditions and screen display differences. For accurate color reference, we recommend viewing under natural daylight (D65 standard).
